test.create_query: CREATE TABLE json_compact_shared_path_cache (id UInt64, j JSON(max_dynamic_paths = 0)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS index_granularity = 1, min_bytes_for_wide_part = '1G', write_marks_for_substreams_in_compact_parts = 0
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO json_compact_shared_path_cache SELECT number, toJSONString(map('a', number, 'b', number + 1)) FROM numbers(8192)
